learning-kit sequence diagrams

How a request moves between the learner, the skills, subagents, the lk core, the browser and the grader, in the seven flows that matter most.

What the sequences show

In short

Every flow has the same shape. A skill or a browser asks; lk checks the request against the files, changes them under the lock, and answers. The slow parts (subagents, web fetches, LLM grading) always run outside the lock. Each quiz, whatever its mode, ends in the same sessions.finish pipeline: grade, then apply side effects exactly once. S1S2

Researching a topic

The skill fans the work out to cheap collector subagents in parallel, then to one aggregator. Only lk writes structured state. The aggregator writes research.md directly, because that file is prose and not state. S3

A gate round, end to end

The skill runs lk serve in the background and gets the URL from its stdout. The browser talks only to the HTTP server, and the server only to service.py. Grading runs in a background thread while the page polls. S5S6

Same flow, other entry pointsThe web app's Gate round, Practice, Start recall and Start checkpoint buttons send POST /api/sessions {kind, …} and then follow the same browser → server → service steps. Only the lk serve lane drops out. S6

Inside finish: grading and side effects

The lock is held twice, briefly. It is not held during the grading in between, which can take minutes. The second lock region re-reads the session first, so if a web thread and lk grade finish at the same time, the side effects still apply once. S1

What _apply writes, per mode S2

Modeattempts.jsonlMistakes log (score < 0.5)Recall cardsMode-specific
gate✓✓— (enrolled later, on scheduled)gate.evaluate + gate.apply: concept status, rounds_log, stage move
practice✓✓—none
review✓✓✓ srs.recordAgain → concept lapsed
checkpoint✓✓✓ srs.recordrecord_checkpoint → path.checkpoints[mid]
placement✗✗✗record_placement → path.placement only

A spaced-recall session

Cards are per item and keyed <topic>/<qid>. A reworded variant gets its own uid, but it keeps origin, so its grade updates the original card. S9S10

Planning and walking a learning path

The plan enters path.json only through a validated import. After that, every session asks lk path next for the single next action, so /path can resume from any session without remembering anything. S12S13

A quiz in chat over MCP

The MCP tools are thin wrappers over the same service calls the browser uses. Questions come back exactly as the browser would show them, without keys, and grading has the same side effects. S14

Reviewing the note and scheduling the topic

The reviewer only scores. lk decides pass or fail with a fixed rule, and on a pass it moves the topic to scheduled, which enrolls its recall cards. S16S17
